question: Find the cost of painting a spherical ball of radius 14 cm at the rate of Rs. 10 per cm². (Use π = (22/7))
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the spherical ball (r) = 14 cm

Rate of painting = Rs. 10 per cm²

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of Sphere = 4πr²

Cost of Painting = Surface Area × Rate
